neighbours.label: the number of a waiting or notice period ('take from 4 to 6 weeks', 'notice (48 hours)', 'up to four weeks to process')
fire: Custom orders usually take from 3 to 5 weeks, so order early.
Refunds require advance notice (72 hours) in writing.
Passport renewals can take up to six weeks to process.
Delivery normally takes from 2 to 4 days after payment.
Cancellations need prior notice (24 hours) by phone.
Visa applications may take up to eight weeks to review.
Repairs generally take from 5 to 7 days, so plan ahead.
Bookings require a notice period (48 hours) in advance.
quiet: Custom shelves usually hold from 3 to 5 boxes, so buy extra.
Refunds come in a large envelope (72 pages) in the mail.
Passport photos can have up to six people in the shop.
Dinner normally costs from 2 to 4 dollars after tax.
Cancellations hit our team (24 players) at the park.
Visa offices may have up to eight desks in the hall.
Shoes generally weigh from 5 to 7 ounces, so pack light.
Bookings fill a large binder (48 sheets) on the desk.
